summary: Confirmed root cause for two consecutive openclaw_fleet_rollout.py implementation failures: both agents (agent_jordanh-gke on attempt 2, agent_jordanh-worker2 on attempt 3) wrote the file to the worktree but did not stage and commit it with `git add` + `git commit` before completing their turn. The deterministic finalizer only commits pre-tracked modified files; brand-new files left untracked are not staged by the finalizer and cause it to refuse the push (dirty worktree). The current task worktree confirms src/mac/openclaw_fleet_rollout.py does not exist.

actionability.root_cause: New files created during task execution were left untracked (not staged and committed) before handoff to the deterministic finalizer. The finalizer only commits modifications to already-tracked files; it refuses to push when untracked or staged-but-not-committed new files are present.
